machine.name: Home Chronic Disease Response Interconnect
machine.description: Published personal-health bridge bus that composes chronic disease control, medication access, transportation access, food security, and activity tolerance into a compact fan-out lane for urgent disease response, access/adherence support, preventive intensification, and stable monitoring. PE owns source composition and writes the compact input lane; RE evaluates this machine as ordinary vector state.

metadata.domain: Personal Health - Published Chronic Disease Response Bus
metadata.author: Reality Engine

publishedDomainBus.name: Personal Health Chronic Disease Response Bus
publishedDomainBus.description: Domain-level published bus for chronic disease control, adherence/access barriers, food security, and activity tolerance interconnection.

downstreamConsumers.purpose: optimize chronic care and support referrals
dispatch care coordination agent for high-risk chronic disease support
guardrail inequitable access and social-driver burden
track chronic disease measures and readiness
crisis benefits intake during acute chronic disease deterioration
Medicaid renewal and coverage continuity watch
SNAP eligibility support when food access affects chronic disease control

fanOutPolicy.notes: PE selects consumers from outputMatchesAny after RE emits the bus output. Urgent disease response, access/adherence support, preventive intensification, and stable monitoring intentionally fan out to different consumers.

writeBack.name: localAIStack chronic disease response resolver completion
semantics: urgent disease response resolved or acknowledged
access adherence support resolved or acknowledged
stable chronic disease monitoring resolved or acknowledged

sourceMapping.name: localAIStack chronic disease response resolver completion

localAIResolver.notes: Resolver metadata is consumed by PE startup configuration. It intentionally does not create metadata.agentBinding because this bridge machine is not an agent-dispatcher and RE should see only ordinary vector state.

rules.description: URGENT_DISEASE_RESPONSE: acute chronic disease deterioration with access/adherence co-risk at [4386:4390]
ACCESS_ADHERENCE_SUPPORT: poor control driven by medication, transportation, or food-access barriers at [4386:4390]
PREVENTIVE_INTENSIFICATION: borderline disease control with early risk signals at [4386:4390]
STABLE_CHRONIC_DISEASE_MONITORING: disease and support lanes stable at [4386:4390]

governance.notes: Published PE-composed bridge bus for chronic disease response. RE evaluates only vector state; PE owns source provenance and completion ingestion.

sequences.name: Disease exacerbation + adherence/access collapse -> urgent disease response

metadata.description: Acute disease deterioration aligns with medication, transportation, nutrition, and activity-risk context.

metadata.action: Route urgent chronic disease response, care coordination, benefits continuity, and clinical escalation review.

sequences.name: Poor control + medication/transport/food access barriers -> access adherence support

metadata.description: Poor chronic disease control appears driven by medication cost, appointment access, and food support gaps.

metadata.action: Route medication access, transportation, benefits, and care-resource support.

sequences.name: Borderline control + early access/activity risk -> preventive intensification

metadata.description: Disease control is near-miss rather than crisis; PE should route to prevention, nutrition, activity, and measure tracking.

metadata.action: Route preventive intensification and chronic disease program follow-up before acute escalation.

sequences.name: Controlled disease + managed supports -> stable chronic disease monitoring

metadata.description: Disease control and support lanes are stable; PE should route only lightweight monitoring consumers.

metadata.action: Continue lightweight monitoring and outcome stabilization.
